title: power-scenarios.json contract
description: Structural contract for asic/<module>/Verification/simulation-plan/power-scenarios.json — one entry per scenario materialized from references/power-scenarios-template.md's standard set. This is the only home; verification-plan.md §4 points here and restates no field. Read by power-analysis alone. Two fields are load-bearing across the stage boundary: power-analysis's own result.schema.json REQUIRES corner_intent and duration_cycles, so an omitted one would surface as a downstream envelope failure rather than here. sequence_ref resolving against sequences.json is not expressible here; the check-scaffold gate enforces it, where both files are in hand.

scenario.description: The standard set's scenario name, materialized for this module (e.g. "200MB/s (low-power off)").

data_state.description: Traffic level this scenario drives: none / no traffic / business_flow / full-toggle, per the standard set.

corner_intent.description: PVT corner this scenario is annotated at (e.g. "SS/125C"). Equivalent scenarios reusing one sequence_ref keep distinct corner_intent — that is what the SAIF-per-ID dedup preserves.

sequence_ref.description: A sequences.json entry's name. The only field emit_power_tests reads; it groups by this and runs each group once.
